newsitem.title: USA: Brush Creek seeks venture partner.
newsitem.headline: Brush Creek seeks venture partner.

text.p: Brush Creek Mining and Development Co Inc said on Tuesday that it has retained Geographe Corporate Advisory Ltd to investigate strategic alternatives, including identifying a joint venture partner for the company.
Geographe specializes in the area of corporate and project acquisitions and divestments in the international mining industry, Brush Creek said.
Brush Creek said this option of a joint venture would be the least dilutive means to bring its property into production compared with an equity offering.
